value.signature: fn resolve_public_reference (records : & ValidatedRecords , reference : & PublicReference ,) -> Result < ReferenceOrigin , ValidationError >

review.body: { let result = if ! valid_reference (reference) { Err (ValidationError :: InvalidReference (reference . clone ())) } else if records . history . references . contains (reference) { Ok (ReferenceOrigin :: History) } else if records . acts . iter () . any (| act | match reference { PublicReference :: Act (id) => id == & act . id , PublicReference :: Edge (id) => act . legs . iter () . any (| leg | & leg . id == id) , PublicReference :: Named { .. } => false , PublicReference :: Minted (id) => { id == & act . id && act . legs . iter () . any (| leg | mints (& act . id , act . body . layout , leg . id . role , & leg . target)) } }) { Ok (ReferenceOrigin :: Batch) } else { Err (ValidationError :: UnresolvedReference (reference . clone ())) } ; if result . is_ok () { metrics :: counter ! ("records__root__sig__design__records__resolved_references") . increment (1) ; } else { refused () ; } result }
review.item_premise: Resolves act and leg identities derived from whole validated history or the batch; full query and typed origin or refusal are public. Minted node queries resolve only a complete self-minting genesis anchor; the public constructor is distinct from act and external-name references.
